cases.title: Desktop owner revocation after preview refuses only A and original-key replay stays deduplicated
cases.source_assessment: The authority projection is evaluated on each authorized read with time.Now().UTC(). Historical diffs show only author_authority.evaluated_at changing. The strict whole-comment/state equality confuses read-time metadata with immutable business facts.
cases.minimum_action: Validate each returned evaluated_at as the current valid timestamp field, then compare all stable state exactly while excluding only author_authority.evaluated_at. Keep role, can_submit_command, author IDs, content/revision, targets, command identities/counts, notifications, attachment bytes/references and original receipt equality unchanged. Never strip the complete authority object or use broad partial equality to hide other mutations.
